meta.scope: Faculty of Engineering, plus Quantity Surveying and Architecture/Interior Design grouped in here by instruction. Note: the source document actually lists Architecture under a separate 'School of Architecture', not the Faculty of Engineering. Local A/L requirements only.
knownDataGaps: Quantity Surveying's Category A accepts 'Higher Mathematics', which isn't offered as a subject option under any stream in this form — only 'Combined Mathematics' from Category A is actually selectable. Students who genuinely took Higher Mathematics can't be matched via this path.

LJMU Quantity Surveying's accepted stream list includes 'Engineering Technology', an A/L subject taken within our generic 'Technology' stream, not a separate stream name — mapped to the Technology stream here.
